__about__: Retail primitives, v3 multi-transaction. AUTH/GET_USER/LOAD_ORDER are reads; PLAN_TXNS builds the transaction queue; POP_TARGET loads one transaction into the working registers; PLAN_CHANGES/WALK_VARIANT/RESOLVE_RETURN_ITEMS prepare item args; DO_* execute one transaction and ADVANCE (clear requested_action+order_status -> next POP) or set resolved when the queue is empty. POP_TARGET/SKIP_TARGET/FINALIZE carry their state mutation on a no-op calculate() call (the executor must emit a tool call; calculate is harmless and always available). Tools return JSON objects or an error string; parse_rules read JSON fields. HILO (gpt-5.4) re-extracts the load-bearing parses (PLAN_TXNS/POP_TARGET/PLAN_CHANGES/WALK_VARIANT/RESOLVE_RETURN_ITEMS/LOAD_ORDER).

base_actions.when: email set and not yet tried
no email, or email already tried

executor_sys_rules: If task_state.customer_email is set and task_state.tried_email is not true, call find_user_id_by_email(email=task_state.customer_email).
Otherwise call find_user_id_by_name_zip(first_name=task_state.customer_first, last_name=task_state.customer_last, zip=task_state.customer_zip). One tool per step, read-only.
parse_rules: The result is the user id string (e.g. 'yusuf_rossi_9620'). Set task_state.user_id to that exact string.
If the tool was find_user_id_by_email set task_state.tried_email=true; if it was find_user_id_by_name_zip set task_state.tried_name=true.
On 'User not found' do not set user_id.

GET_USER.goal_template: load the customer profile (orders + payment methods)
parse_rules: The result is the user JSON. Set task_state.user_loaded = true.
Set task_state.candidate_order_ids to a JSON array of the customer's order ids (the 'orders' field).

PLAN_TXNS.goal_template: parse the full request into an ordered queue of transactions
executor_sys_rules: Call get_user_details(user_id=task_state.user_id) to see the customer's orders and statuses, so you can plan. Read-only.
parse_rules: The result is the user JSON (has 'orders'). Read the customer's full request from the goal and build task_state.txn_queue: a JSON array with ONE entry per distinct transaction the customer wants, each = {"action": one of 'cancel'/'modify_address'/'modify_payment'/'modify_user_address'/'modify_items'/'exchange'/'return', "order_id": the target order id (or null if it applies to no specific order), "details": the FULL relevant detail VERBATIM from the goal (which items + their new options, the new address, the reason) — do NOT over-summarize; later steps rely on it}.

Action mapping: wants the order undone / can't pay / placed by mistake -> 'cancel'. Wants a different card/giftcard for an order -> 'modify_payment'. Wants a different shipping address for an order -> 'modify_address'. Wants different item options on a PENDING order -> 'modify_items'. Wants different item options on a DELIVERED order -> 'exchange'. Wants money back for delivered items -> 'return'.

If the customer says 'cancel ALL pending orders' or 'return/cancel everything', emit one 'cancel' (or 'return') entry per order id in the customer's orders — non-applicable ones will be skipped automatically.
If a request is conditional ('change X, but if unavailable cancel'), emit the PRIMARY action ('modify_items' or 'exchange'); the walk will fall back to cancel if no variant is available.
Use REAL order ids from the orders list. Emit at least one entry.

POP_TARGET.goal_template: load the next transaction from the queue into the working registers

base_actions.when: always (no-op carrier; the real work is in parse_rules)

executor_sys_rules: Call calculate with expression '1'. This is a no-op; it just lets the loop advance.
parse_rules: Ignore the calculate result. Take the FIRST entry of task_state.txn_queue.
Set task_state.requested_action = that entry's action. Set task_state.order_id = that entry's order_id (or null). Set task_state.txn_details = that entry's details.
If the action is 'cancel', set task_state.cancel_reason from the details ('ordered by mistake' if the details say a mistake, else 'no longer needed').

If the action is 'modify_address' or 'modify_user_address', set new_address1/new_address2/new_city/new_state/new_zip/new_country from the details IF the details give a full address; otherwise leave them null (a later step will merge with the existing address).
CONSUME the head: set task_state.txn_queue to the SAME array with its first entry removed, or null if it was the last entry.
CLEAR the per-order working registers: set task_state.order_status=null, task_state.order_items=null, task_state.item_ids=null, task_state.new_item_ids=null, task_state.change_plan=null.

SKIP_TARGET.goal_template: skip a transaction whose precondition is not met (e.g. cancel a non-pending order), advance to the next
executor_sys_rules: Call calculate with expression '1'. No-op; the loop advances in parse_rules.
parse_rules: Ignore the result. This transaction cannot be performed (its order is not in the required status). ADVANCE: set task_state.requested_action=null, task_state.order_status=null, task_state.order_id=null.
If task_state.txn_queue is null (this was the last transaction), also set task_state.resolved=true.

LOAD_ORDER.goal_template: read the current transaction's order: status, items, original payment

args.order_id: <task_state.order_id, or — if null — the order id from the customer's orders matching txn_details>

executor_sys_rules: Call get_order_details (read-only, keep the leading '#'). If task_state.order_id is set, read it; otherwise pick the order from the customer's orders that matches task_state.txn_details and read it.
parse_rules: The result is the order JSON. Set task_state.order_id to its 'order_id'. Set task_state.order_status to its 'status' verbatim.
Set task_state.order_items to a JSON array of its items as {"item_id":..,"product_id":..,"name":..,"options":..}.
Set task_state.payment_method_id to payment_history[0].payment_method_id (the order's original payment).

PLAN_CHANGES.goal_template: plan which order items to change and to what new options for the current transaction
executor_sys_rules: Re-read get_order_details(order_id=task_state.order_id) to see the items. Read-only.
parse_rules: The result is the order JSON with an 'items' list. Match the request (task_state.txn_details AND the overall task_state.goal) against the items.

Set task_state.change_plan to a JSON array with ONE entry per item to change: {"old_item_id": <REAL item_id>, "product_id": <REAL product_id>, "desired_options": <short text of the new options for THIS item>}.
Include EVERY item the customer wants changed in this transaction — if they mention two items (e.g. a keyboard AND a thermostat), the array MUST have two entries. Use REAL ids.

WALK_VARIANT.goal_template: resolve one planned change into (old_item_id -> available new variant), consuming change_plan; fall back to cancel if no variant is available

args.product_id: <the product_id of the FIRST entry in task_state.change_plan>

executor_sys_rules: Call get_product_details with the FIRST change_plan entry's product_id. Read-only. One entry per step.
parse_rules: The result is the product JSON; 'variants' maps REAL item_id -> {options, available, price}.
Take the FIRST entry of task_state.change_plan. Among AVAILABLE variants, pick the item_id whose options match that entry's desired_options (use a REAL variant id).

If a matching AVAILABLE variant exists: APPEND that entry's old_item_id to task_state.item_ids (current list or [] plus it), and APPEND the chosen new variant id to task_state.new_item_ids. Then CONSUME the head: if change_plan had MORE THAN ONE entry, set task_state.change_plan to the SAME array WITHOUT its first entry (keep the rest!); ONLY set it to null when the entry you just processed was the LAST one.

If NO available variant matches (the conditional fallback): the customer said to cancel in that case — set task_state.requested_action='cancel', task_state.cancel_reason='no longer needed', and task_state.change_plan=null (the order is pending so DO_CANCEL will run).

RESOLVE_RETURN_ITEMS.goal_template: determine which order item_ids to return for the current transaction
executor_sys_rules: Re-read get_order_details(order_id=task_state.order_id) to see the items. Read-only.
parse_rules: The result is the order JSON with an 'items' list. Set task_state.item_ids to a JSON array of the item_id(s) to RETURN — match task_state.txn_details against the items by name/options.
Include EVERY item the customer wants returned in this transaction (often several). If they say 'everything' / 'all', include every item_id. Use REAL item_ids.

DO_CANCEL.goal_template: cancel the current pending order, then advance
executor_sys_rules: Call cancel_pending_order(order_id=task_state.order_id, reason=task_state.cancel_reason) — reason must be 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'. Once.
parse_rules: The result is the updated order JSON. If its 'status' is now 'cancelled', the transaction succeeded.
On success: if task_state.txn_queue is null (last transaction) set task_state.resolved=true; otherwise ADVANCE — set task_state.requested_action=null and task_state.order_status=null.
On error, set nothing.

DO_MODIFY_ADDRESS.goal_template: modify the current pending order's shipping address, then advance
executor_sys_rules: Call modify_pending_order_address. Build the FULL address: start from the order's CURRENT address (you saw it in the order details) and apply ONLY the change the customer asked for in task_state.txn_details (e.g. if they only change the unit, keep address1/city/state/zip and set address2). If task_state.new_address1 etc are set, use them. Once.
parse_rules: The result is the updated order JSON. If it is a valid order (not an error), the transaction succeeded.
On success: if task_state.txn_queue is null set task_state.resolved=true; otherwise set task_state.requested_action=null and task_state.order_status=null.

DO_MODIFY_PAYMENT.goal_template: modify the current pending order's payment method, then advance

args.payment_method_id: <the NEW payment method id from txn_details, different from the original>

executor_sys_rules: Call modify_pending_order_payment(order_id, payment_method_id=the NEW method the customer wants, different from the order's current one). Once.
parse_rules: The result is the updated order JSON. If it is a valid order (not an error), the transaction succeeded.
On success: if task_state.txn_queue is null set task_state.resolved=true; otherwise set task_state.requested_action=null and task_state.order_status=null.

DO_MODIFY_USER_ADDRESS.goal_template: modify the customer's default account address, then advance
executor_sys_rules: Call modify_user_address(user_id, full new address fields from task_state.txn_details / new_address*). Once.
parse_rules: The result is the updated user JSON. If valid (not an error), success.
On success: if task_state.txn_queue is null set task_state.resolved=true; otherwise set task_state.requested_action=null and task_state.order_status=null.

DO_RETURN.goal_template: request a return of the current delivered items, then advance
executor_sys_rules: Call return_delivered_order_items(order_id, item_ids=task_state.item_ids, payment_method_id=task_state.payment_method_id — original payment or an existing gift card). Once.
parse_rules: The result is the updated order JSON. If its 'status' is now 'return requested', success.
On success: if task_state.txn_queue is null set task_state.resolved=true; otherwise set task_state.requested_action=null and task_state.order_status=null and task_state.item_ids=null.

DO_EXCHANGE.goal_template: exchange the current delivered items, then advance
parse_rules: The result is the updated order JSON. If its 'status' is now 'exchange requested', success.

On success: if task_state.txn_queue is null set task_state.resolved=true; otherwise set task_state.requested_action=null and task_state.order_status=null and task_state.item_ids=null and task_state.new_item_ids=null.

DO_MODIFY_ITEMS.goal_template: modify the current pending order's items, then advance
executor_sys_rules: Call modify_pending_order_items(order_id, item_ids=task_state.item_ids, new_item_ids=task_state.new_item_ids, payment_method_id=task_state.payment_method_id). Can be called only ONCE — include all items. Once.
parse_rules: The result is the updated order JSON. If its 'status' is now 'pending (item modified)', success.

On success: if task_state.txn_queue is null set task_state.resolved=true; otherwise set task_state.requested_action=null and task_state.order_status=null and task_state.item_ids=null and task_state.new_item_ids=null.

FINALIZE.goal_template: all queued transactions are done — close the task
parse_rules: Ignore the result. The transaction queue is empty and all transactions were handled. Set task_state.resolved=true.

ESCALATE.goal_template: transfer to a human agent when the request cannot be completed

args.summary: <one-line summary of the request and why it cannot be completed>

base_actions.when: task_state.resolved == false and no remaining applicable action

executor_sys_rules: Transfer (transfer_to_human_agents ONCE) only when no applicable action remains. Concise summary.
parse_rules: After 'Transfer successful' set task_state.escalated=true; this ends the workflow.
